newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares off, BTC leads way.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares off, BTC leads way.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.11 percent on Wednesday, dragged down by profit-taking in shopping centre operator BTC.

Traders forecast little movement in the overall market ahead of a decision by parliament on whether to ratify an association agreement with the European Union. Parliament is expected to vote on the issue within two weeks.
The SBI index fell 0.11 percent or 1.49 points to 1,317.40.
"Parliament's decision will be crucial for momentum and liquidity. Ratification would improve Slovenia's international reputation and lure fresh foreign capital," a trader said.
Dealers said prices could jump by about 10 percent on a 'yes' vote and fall by up to 30 percent on a 'no'.
Overall seven shares fell, six rose, one was unchanged and 14 untraded.
Turnover fell to 55.2 million tolars from 80.3 million.
Warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC was the most active share, falling 1.45 percent to 14,290 tolars on volume of 972 shares for total turnover of 13.9 million tolars.
Traders said the drop was a correction to recent gains.
Preferred shares of trading company Kovinotehna led the day's decliners, falling 2.22 percent to 440 tolars on volume of 645 shares.
Bank Probanka was the top gainer, rising 3.93 percent to 20,900 tolars on volume of just 30 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
